subtopics.label: Extent of Surgical Resection in Early-Stage NSCLC
subtopics.description: Research comparing lobectomy, segmentectomy, and wedge resection for early-stage non-small cell lung cancer, focusing on oncologic outcomes, locoregional recurrence, survival, and lymph node dissection strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Comparative oncologic outcomes of lobectomy, segmentectomy, and wedge resection for early-stage NSCLC.

subtopics.label: Neoadjuvant Immunotherapy and Radiation in NSCLC
subtopics.description: Clinical trials and analyses evaluating neoadjuvant durvalumab, stereotactic body radiotherapy, and chemoimmunotherapy combinations in resectable non-small cell lung cancer, including pathologic response rates, surgical feasibility, and survival outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Pathologic response rates and survival outcomes from neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy and SBRT in resectable NSCLC.

subtopics.label: Lung Cancer Screening, Access, and Racial Disparities
subtopics.description: Studies examining lung cancer screening utilization, guideline eligibility, racial and ethnic disparities, risk-model-based screening approaches, and implementation strategies to improve screening uptake in diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Utilization gaps, guideline eligibility, and risk-model strategies to improve screening uptake across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Molecular Drivers and Targeted Therapy in Lung Cancer
subtopics.description: Research on oncogenic driver mutations (EGFR, KRAS, ALK, LKB1) and targeted therapeutic strategies in lung adenocarcinoma and NSCLC, including resistance mechanisms, allelic variation, and drug sensitivity profiles.
subtopics.short_description: EGFR, KRAS, ALK, and LKB1 driver mutations, resistance mechanisms, and targeted drug sensitivity in NSCLC.

subtopics.label: Tumor Microenvironment and Immune Evasion in Lung Cancer
subtopics.description: Investigations into the lung cancer tumor microenvironment, including immune cell dynamics, immune evasion mechanisms (EMSY, IRE1α, PD-L1/EGFR interactions), and the evolution of immunity from preinvasive to invasive adenocarcinoma.
subtopics.short_description: Immune cell dynamics, PD-L1/EGFR interactions, and evasion mechanisms from preinvasive to invasive adenocarcinoma.

subtopics.label: Second Primary Lung Cancer Risk and Surveillance
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing the incidence, risk prediction, racial differences, and clinical impact of second primary lung cancers among lung cancer survivors, including validated risk models and surveillance recommendations.
subtopics.short_description: Incidence, risk prediction models, and surveillance recommendations for second primary cancers in lung cancer survivors.

subtopics.label: Genomic Profiling, Liquid Biopsy, and Molecular Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Research on next-generation sequencing, cell-free DNA, circulating tumor DNA, and fusion detection methods applied to lung cancer diagnosis, molecular profiling, and treatment monitoring.
subtopics.short_description: Cell-free DNA, circulating tumor DNA, and NGS-based fusion detection for diagnosis and treatment monitoring.

subtopics.label: Small Cell Lung Cancer Biology and Histological Transformation
subtopics.description: Studies on the molecular biology of small cell lung cancer, including TP53/RB1 deficiency, MYC overexpression, lineage plasticity, and histological transformation from lung adenocarcinoma to SCLC.
subtopics.short_description: TP53/RB1 deficiency, MYC overexpression, lineage plasticity, and adenocarcinoma-to-SCLC transformation mechanisms.

subtopics.label: Metabolic Reprogramming and Vulnerabilities in Lung Cancer
subtopics.description: Research identifying metabolic alterations in lung cancer cells, including serine/one-carbon metabolism, propionate metabolism, and LKB1-dependent metabolic regulation, as potential therapeutic targets.
subtopics.short_description: Serine, one-carbon, and LKB1-dependent metabolic alterations in lung cancer cells as actionable vulnerabilities.

subtopics.label: Surgical Outcomes and Perioperative Management in Lung Cancer
subtopics.description: Studies on perioperative factors affecting lung cancer surgery outcomes, including pulmonary function testing before resection, intraoperative opioid exposure, COVID-19 impact on surgical safety, and nodal staging quality metrics.
subtopics.short_description: Pulmonary function, opioid exposure, nodal staging quality, and COVID-19 impact on lung cancer surgery safety.

subtopics.label: Immunotherapy Response Biomarkers and Checkpoint Inhibition
subtopics.description: Research identifying molecular and genomic biomarkers predictive of response to immune checkpoint inhibitors in lung cancer, including PD-L1 expression, proliferation gene signatures, and tumor-immune interactions.
subtopics.short_description: PD-L1 expression, proliferation gene signatures, and tumor-immune features predicting checkpoint inhibitor response.

subtopics.label: Pulmonary Nodule Detection and Management
subtopics.description: Studies on the identification, imaging, follow-up, and clinical management of pulmonary nodules, including incidental findings, emergency department programs, and CT-guided biopsy techniques.
subtopics.short_description: Imaging follow-up, incidental findings, CT-guided biopsy, and clinical management protocols for pulmonary nodules.

subtopics.label: Treatment Disparities and Survival Outcomes in Lung Cancer
subtopics.description: Analyses of racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in access to guideline-concordant care, immunotherapy, and survival outcomes among lung cancer patients in the United States.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic gaps in guideline-concordant care, immunotherapy access, and survival in the U.S.

subtopics.label: Preclinical Models and Novel Drug Delivery in Lung Cancer
subtopics.description: Research using patient-derived xenografts, in vitro/in vivo cancer models, and engineered nanoparticle-drug conjugates to identify actionable pathways and improve therapeutic delivery in lung cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Patient-derived xenografts and engineered nanoparticle conjugates to identify pathways and improve therapeutic delivery.

subtopics.label: Combination Immunotherapy and CAR T-Cell Strategies in Solid Tumors
subtopics.description: Studies investigating combinatorial approaches to enhance anti-tumor immunity, including MEK inhibitor scheduling with checkpoint blockade and radiation-enhanced CAR T-cell therapy in solid tumor models.
subtopics.short_description: MEK inhibitor scheduling with checkpoint blockade and radiation-enhanced CAR T-cell therapy in solid tumor models.

subtopics.label: Cancer Screening Adherence, Health Literacy, and Access Barriers
subtopics.description: Population-level analyses examining adherence to guideline-recommended cancer screening, health literacy as a mortality predictor, and utilization of imaging modalities across cancer types and patient subgroups.
subtopics.short_description: Population-level adherence to guideline-recommended screening, health literacy as a mortality predictor, and imaging utilization.

subtopics.label: Pan-Cancer Biomarkers, Mutation Detection, and Molecular Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Cross-cancer studies evaluating novel mutation detection assays, ERBB2/HER2 copy number gain by NGS, and circulating tumor macrophage-like cells as pan-cancer diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers.
subtopics.short_description: ERBB2/HER2 copy number gain, novel mutation assays, and circulating tumor macrophage-like cells as cross-cancer diagnostics.

subtopics.label: Treatment Delay Modeling and Tumor Microbiome in Cancer Progression
subtopics.description: Research quantifying the impact of treatment delays on tumor control and metastasis risk, alongside pan-cancer mycobiome analyses linking fungal communities to gastrointestinal and lung tumor progression.
subtopics.short_description: Quantifying delay-driven metastasis risk and pan-cancer mycobiome links to gastrointestinal and lung tumor progression.
